subject: Request: Freeze-exception to allow 6mo contractor backfill during review cycle
messages:
From: irene_choi@redwood.com
To: markus_klein@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: Freeze-exception to allow 6mo contractor backfill during review cycle

Hi Markus / Grace / Laura –

Quick background: Senior Engineer (Alex M.) notified yesterday they are leaving effective 12/20 for personal reasons. Alex is on a critical infra codepath for the serving runtime and is the only IC with current ownership of the hot-path shards for K/V cache management. Given the timing (end of review cycle + scheduled infra migration in Jan), I am requesting a freeze-exception to allow a 6-month contractor backfill while we assess long-term HC tradeoffs in Q1.

Why this is time-sensitive:
- Knowledge gap: there is a 2–3 week ramp to reach safe oncall handover for the migration.
- Review cycle: we do not want review outcomes to be biased by short-term operational risk (we will complete calibration as planned).
- Business risk: missed migration windows add an estimated 12–18% latency regression risk for several customer-facing models.

Proposed ask (summary):
1) Approve freeze-exception for a 6-month contractor role (temp bench) reporting to Grace; headcount not increased beyond the cap because this will be a contractor conversion off the bench.
2) Budget: transfer from infra contingency line (code 5012-PLAT) – see attached staffing_impact.xlsx for costs.
3) Onboarding: overlap week with Alex for knowledge transfer (12/13–12/20).

Attachments: staffing_impact.xlsx (cost/impact), contractor_estimates.pdf.
Doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3c-ic-backfill-moplan (mutual action plan + interview checklist).

Can I get a yes/no by end of day tomorrow? If approved, I will engage PeoplePartner and post the req to TalentBench (contractor vendor) for immediate shortlisting.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Senior Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: markus_klein@redwood.com
To: irene_choi@redwood.com
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 10:01:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Freeze-exception to allow 6mo contractor backfill during review cycle

Irene –

Thanks for the quick note and the attachments. High level I’m sympathetic to the operational risk here. A few follow-ups before I sign off:

1) Headcount delta: confirm that this will be a contractor headcount only and will not convert into a net new FTE in the HC plan unless we explicitly convert after Q1. Please add the language to the freeze_exception_form.pdf if you can.
2) Finance: Laura, can you confirm the transfer from 5012-PLAT is acceptable for a 6mo contractor and whether we need an amendment to the Q4 forecast?
3) Contingency: can we get a list of three prioritized migration tasks Alex owns so I understand the single points of failure we must cover. If we can shift a low-priority task to another team temporarily, we might reduce the scope of the contractor.

If we can get those answers today I will approve the exception. If we can’t, I want to discuss a fallback (two 3-month contractors vs one 6-month).

Markus Klein
VP, Infrastructure & Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
To: markus_klein@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 11:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Freeze-exception to allow 6mo contractor backfill during review cycle

Markus / Irene –

Agree with the ask. A few operational notes from the team side:
- Prioritized handover list attached in-line (excerpt below):
  1) KV cache merge/evict path (migration blocker)
  2) Online LRU compaction toggle and rollback playbook
  3) Token routing shard mapping adjustments for region failover

- Hiring suggestion: start with a 6-month contractor with weekly checkpoints and an explicit conversion decision gate on 2/15/2027. That gives us time to decide based on Q1 outcomes and avoids an immediate HC bump.
- Ramp plan: I will have two senior SREs do a shadow transfer during 12/13–12/20 and produce runbook updates. That reduces risk to one-week overlap rather than two.

Irene, I updated the staffing_impact.xlsx with the ramp days and new cost estimates — see v2 in attachments.

Grace O'Connor
Director, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: peoplepartner@consulthr.co
To: irene_choi@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Freeze-exception to allow 6mo contractor backfill during review cycle

Thanks for including ConsultHR. A few compliance and practical items to note:

- Contractor classification: for a 6-month engagement we recommend a Statement of Work (SOW) vs an open contractor bench to mitigate misclassification risk. We can provide an SOW template (I can send draft today).
- Background checks / NDAs: standard for infra roles. We can expedite on a 48–72 hour turnaround if you provide candidate PII immediately after shortlisting.
- Freeze-exception form: please fill section B (duration and replacement rationale) — we cannot process without it.

Irene — I will stand by to draft the SOW and provide a candidate shortlist from TalentBench if approved.

Best,
Morgan Patel
Senior PeoplePartner (ConsultHR)
peoplepartner@consulthr.co

[attachment: contractor_estimates.pdf (vendor bids)]

From: irene_choi@redwood.com
To: markus_klein@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Final: Freeze-exception signoff request (summary + next steps)

Markus / Grace / Laura –

Summary and requested approvals: based on the responses above, here's the finalized ask and timeline:

- Role: temporary contractor (6 months) to cover Alex M.'s infra hot-path ownership. No automatic FTE conversion without explicit Q1 approval.
- Budget: transfer from 5012-PLAT; Laura confirmed funds are available for this one-off.
- Compliance: PeoplePartner (ConsultHR) will issue SOW and expedite checks.
- Ramp: shadow transfer 12/13–12/20; contractor start target 12/21.
- Decision gate: 2/15/2027 conversion decision.

Attachments: freeze_exception_form.pdf (filled — see section B: duration + rationale), staffing_impact_v2.xlsx, contractor_estimates.pdf.

Can one of you please provide an explicit signoff (reply-all with APPROVED) so I can engage TalentBench and PeoplePartner today?

Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick coordination.

Irene Choi
Senior Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
